meta.name: Through the Darkness
meta.description: A team of tenacious detectives study the minds of murderers at a time when Korea's first serial murders terrorized the nation. Based on true events.

videos.title: Red Cap Incident
videos.overview: Song Ha-yeong pursues a criminal known for targeting young women. Kook Yeong-su looks to form a team of criminal behavioral analysts.

videos.title: Habits of Criminals
videos.overview: Ha-yeong consults a criminal to understand a killer’s motives. An arrest leads to a startling interrogation session and a break in the case.

videos.title: Ha-yeong Meets Tae-gu Again
videos.overview: The grisly murder of a child catches the attention of Ha-yeong and Yeong-su. A determined police captain clashes with the team.

videos.title: What Must We Remember?
videos.overview: When a suspect’s home is searched, the police make a gruesome discovery. Ha-yeong and Yeong-su grow frustrated as the investigation continues.

videos.title: Looking into the Minds of Evil
videos.overview: A crooked new police chief causes trouble for the team. The deaths of a professor and his wife touch off a series of brutal murders.

videos.title: The Man With the Hiking Boots
videos.overview: Yoon Tae-gu and Kim Bong-sik seek to set boundaries on the behavioral analysis team. A complex investigation sends the police down a twisted path.

videos.title: A Scary Wolf Inside the Rabbit Burrow
videos.overview: Ha-yeong spends time with his mother on his birthday. With two killers on the loose, the investigators are faced with high-pressure stakes.

videos.title: There Are No Perfect Crimes
videos.overview: A chase takes a risky turn. When a suspect asks for a high-ranking officer, Ha-yeong hatches a plan. A search for victims' bodies continues.

videos.title: Becoming the Monster
videos.overview: The behavioral analysis team agrees to an interview with a journalist. Ha-yeong seeks to enter the killer’s mind, but it takes a toll on him.

videos.title: I Just Liked It
videos.overview: During interviews and crime scene reenactments, Ha-yeong and the police dive deep into a ruthless suspect's psyche and past trauma.

videos.title: The Victims And Their Families
videos.overview: A horrific accident forces Ha-yeong to reflect on the mental impact of his work. Meanwhile, two people go missing from a karaoke bar, raising suspicions.

videos.title: The Hearts of Criminals
videos.overview: Police and the analysis team investigate a murder suspect who is known for charming women and luring them into his car.
